basic_info.description: Enjoy the best of San Francisco in this renovated 3-bedroom, 1-bathroom condo, perfectly situated in Russian Hill just steps from North Beach. Built in 1906, this charming residence blends classic elements with contemporary upgrades, featuring a newly remodeled kitchen and bathroom, and in-unit washer and dryer. In this unbeatable location, you're just steps from the vibrant North Beach neighborhood, offering exceptional year-round weather and an array of world-class shops, acclaimed restaurants, and picturesque parks. Boasting a Walk Score of 100, daily errands and explorations are a breeze. Enjoy easy access to downtown and public transit. This unit also offers the convenience of one-car parking and dedicated storage.
